hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the repeated-kernel template K(n)*theta by replacing theta with the member-specific companion value. For K(n), theta=1 and multiplicative identity reduces the instantiated template to K(n).
required_assumptions: Multiplication is associative/commutative as reported by the MatchPy AC backend.
Multiplicative identity simplification K(n)*1 -> K(n) is available.
hypotheses.rationale: F01 reports a one-hole AC/LGG product pattern K(n)*theta with theta in {a(n), b(n)}. F02 reports K(n) as the shared CSE subexpression. Treating K(n) as a repeated kernel and theta as a single companion parameter explains both non-identical product forms and the shared bare subexpression without claiming a closed-form simplification beyond the symbolic template.
